translation_notes: prefixes: RDF->rdf, XSD->xsd, plus the ns_def_local local sd = Namespace("...") as a third @prefix.
sd is only ever used through attribute access (sd.Service, sd.endpoint, sd.resultFormat) to build terms, so no `as NAME` binding is needed.
The three isolated g.add(...) calls become one @graph g declaration plus one +{ } per add (add_isolated pattern), rather than g{ } literals merged with +=: same cardinality, no refactoring.

driver.py fixture: `self` is stood in for by a URIRef subclass carrying .endpoint/.result_format, since the original passes an IdentifiedNode straight into the triples; two calls cover both optional attributes present and both absent.

repair.driver: quatre appels ajoutés : endpoint seul, result_format seul (chaque garde décide seule), et deux sujets TermMapLike, une IdentifiedNode ni URIRef ni BNode imitant TermMap (__eq__/__hash__ sur _id, id URIRef puis BNode) et SPARQLSource (str -> URIRef, valeur falsy -> None), le type réel de self dans pyrml ; son n3() délègue à _id pour que le harnais puisse canonicaliser le graphe.
mutants_killed: garde du triplet resultFormat remplacée par `if self.endpoint`
garde du triplet endpoint remplacée par `if self.result_format`
sujet du triplet de type forcé en IRI (URIRef(self._id)) au lieu de l'objet self

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the type triple is added where the graph is built, `g = Graph().add((self, RDF.type, sd.Service))` (Graph.add returns the graph), and the two local annotations (`g: Graph`, `sd: Namespace`) go. The two conditional adds stay: nothing else to compress.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: the same fold as a graph literal, `g = g{ {self} a sd:Service }`, then `@graph g` and one `+{ }` per conditional add; `@prefix sd:` stays in the function block. No exception to the symmetry rule.
header_optimization_notes: optimized_header.py: URIRef, IdentifiedNode and XSD are unused: the two imports become `from rdflib import Graph, Namespace, RDF`.

optimized_header.ldpy: no import is left (`g{ }` builds the graph, `a` replaces rdf:type, sd: is a prefix), and neither of the two `@prefix rdf:`/`xsd:` lines is used: the header is reduced to its provenance comments.
